dt-example.title: Default state
dt-example.info:
When you are adding [predefined states](./main.html), you might wish to make one of them the default state of the table when it is loaded. This is possible through the `isDefault` property of the `-type StateRestore.Predefined` objects in the `-init stateRestore.predefined` array.
This example is identical to the simple predefined case, but here the _Search and order_ state is flagged as the default, and if you load the page (or reload), you'll see that this is the state that is applied to the table.
